name.description: The key of `[mcp_servers.<name>]`; 1-32 letters, digits, `_` or `-`.

oauth.description: Remote server: the user's own OAuth client, used before any other identity.

parallel_tools.description: Every tool of this server may run in parallel with other read-only tools.

required.description: The first request always waits for this server, and a task fails without it.

startup_timeout_secs.description: Longest connection attempt: start, handshake and tool list. Default 30.

transport.description: Remote server: Streamable HTTP, or the older HTTP+SSE. Absent: SSE when the URL ends in `/sse`, else Streamable HTTP.

url.description: Remote server: the Streamable HTTP endpoint.

McpServerInfo.description: The latest status of one server, as kept in a session snapshot.

tools.description: Tools offered after filtering, when ready.

oneOf.description: Connecting: starting the process, the handshake, the tool list.
Could not connect, or the connection was lost. Calls try to reconnect.
Signs in with OAuth, and there is no usable token: someone has to sign in.
Shut down with the session.

McpServerView.description: One server as the page shows it; secrets never appear, only the names they are saved under.

auth_partial.description: Authenticated, but the provider did not grant every requested permission.

connector.description: Curated CLI connector, when installed through connectors/install.

credentials.description: The credentials its configuration refers to.

disabled_by.description: When disabled: the layer that turned it off.

editable.description: Defined in a file finx writes for the user.

icon.description: The service's logo as a `data:` URI, when one was found (mcp-design §13.9).

identity.description: Which service it reaches, whatever its name: two servers with the same identity are the same service (mcp-design §13.10).

layer.description: The layer that defines the server (its command or URL).

summary.description: The command line, or the URL without its query.

oneOf.description: A session open now is connected to it.
The last connection's result (`~/.finx/mcp/cache`).
Never connected with this configuration.
Defined in a project that is not trusted, so sessions do not start it.
The older HTTP+SSE transport.

Message.description: A message of the conversation. The parts are shared: the session history and every request built from it point at the same data, so cloning a message is cheap.

details.description: For user interfaces and logs; never sent to the model.

default_thinking.description: The level a session starts with on this model: the one last chosen on it, else its configured default, else `default`.

known.description: Its details come from somewhere; `false` means default limits.

shown.description: In the model menu (the defaults and the user's choices).

thinking_levels.description: The provider's own thinking levels this model offers, `off` when it can be switched off; `default` (the provider decides) is always possible and not listed. Empty: no control.

defaults.description: What a new session starts with when `session/new` leaves a setting out.

providers.description: Every provider with where its credentials come from.

catalog.description: Refresh the public model catalog too.

provider.description: One provider; all with credentials when absent.

shown.description: In the model menu or not.

oneOf.description: User input. Starts a task when the session is idle; queued by `mode` otherwise.

commands.description: Whether a leading `/name` is a command: a built-in one such as `/compact`, or a skill, whose instructions replace it. Front ends leave it out; messages between agents set false.

oneOf.description: Starts again from a message the user sent earlier: the running task stops, the conversation goes back to just before that message, and `input` takes its place. Nothing changes until this op: `session_rewound` says it happened, a `warning` with the code `resend_rejected` that it did not (docs/kernel/message-resend-design.md).

message_id.description: The `message_id` of a user message on the current branch.

oneOf.description: Continue from the current history (retry after a failure).
Takes input that waits for the running task out of the queue: `input_withdrawn` says it went. Nothing happens once it has joined the history.
Moves waiting input to the other mode, at the end of it.
Ends the running step, the model's reply or its tool calls, so that waiting steering input joins the history now; the task goes on. Nothing happens when no steering input waits or an approval does.
Stops one sub-agent's current task. It keeps its session and takes messages again; its report arrives as an interrupted one and does not wake the session.
Answers what a sub-agent asks: its `approval_requested`, carried by an `agent_event`.
Names the session; recorded in its log, at any time.
Archives the session or brings it back; recorded in its log, at any time.

PageQuads.description: A selection's rectangles on one page.

PermissionMode.description: How much the session may do without asking. Deny and ask rules apply in every mode. Deserializing also accepts the names used before protocol version 2.

oneOf.description: Every file change and every command that is not known to be read-only asks first.
File changes and simple file-system commands inside the workspace run without asking.
Everything runs without asking, protected paths included. Only deny rules, ask rules and deleting a critical path still stop an action.
Injected at the next turn boundary of the running task.
Processed when the running task would otherwise finish.

ProviderListing.description: A provider's model list as the kernel last saw it.

error.description: Why the last refresh failed; the older list is still in use.

refreshing.description: A refresh is running in the background.

shown.description: Of those, the ones in the model menu.

credential_source.description: The environment variable the key comes from, when `credential` is `env`.

key_env.description: Environment variables that may hold the key.

listing.description: Where its models came from; absent while it has no credentials.

plan.description: Subscription product metadata; API-key authentication alone does not imply a plan.

QueuedInput.description: Input waiting for the running task.

id.description: Given when it was queued: the `message_id` it has once it joins the history.

Rect.description: A rectangle on a page: `x0 < x1`, `y0 < y1`.

ResolvedPart.description: What the kernel read on one page of a selection.

prompt.description: What each run is told to do.

upcoming.description: The next runs, RFC 3339. Empty when it is paused or finished.

RoutineOutcome.description: How a run of a routine ended.

oneOf.description: It had something to say, which went to the bot.
It found nothing to report.
Someone stopped it, or the service closed or crashed while it ran.
The run before it had not finished.

RoutineRunBrief.description: A routine's latest run, for its row.

delivered.description: RFC 3339: when the bot next messaged the user, after a report.

started.description: RFC 3339: when it started, or when it was due if it was skipped.

delivered.description: RFC 3339: when the bot next messaged the user, after a report.

has_log.description: Its steps are still kept: `bots/routine_run` returns them.

late.description: It started well after it was due: the computer was off or asleep.

note.description: What a quiet run says it checked; why a run was skipped.

report.description: What it reported, or the error it failed with.

started.description: RFC 3339. None when it was skipped.

oneOf.description: A one-off that has run.

RoutineSummary.description: A routine as a list shows it.

next_run.description: RFC 3339. None when it is paused or finished.

when.description: The schedule in the user's words, as the bot wrote it.

RowHeight.description: A row whose height is not the default, in pixels, or hidden.

agents.description: Sub-agents: `agent_event`, `agents` in snapshots, `mail` on transcript messages, and the `agent_interrupt` op.

customize.description: The 自定义 page's methods: `config/*`, `credentials/*`, `skills/install`, `skills/remove`, `skills/set_enabled`, `skills/files`, `mcp/list`, `mcp/tools`, `mcp/check`, and their notifications (docs/desktop/customize-design.md §6).

embedded_browser.description: `browser/host` and `browser/cdp`: a client can show the browser tools' pages (browser-design §8.3).

input_queue.description: Input that waits for the running task, as a client shows and changes it: `queue_changed`, `input_withdrawn`, the `withdraw`, `requeue` and `steer_now` ops, and `returned_input` on `task_failed` (docs/kernel/input-queue-design.md).

message_resend.description: Starting again from an earlier message: the `resend` op and `session_rewound` (docs/kernel/message-resend-design.md).

model_discovery.description: Model lists asked from providers (docs/kernel/model-catalog-design.md §8): `shown`, `known`, `deprecated` on models, `listing` on providers, `models/refresh`, `models/show`, and a checked `auth/set`.

routines.description: A bot's routines: the `bots/routine*` methods and `routines` on `BotSummary` (docs/kernel/routine-design.md §8).

sessions_subscribe.description: `sessions/subscribe`, `sessions/changed`, and the state fields of SessionSummary.

workbooks.description: `doc/open` opens workbooks (xlsx, xlsm, xls, csv, tsv) as well as PDFs, and the workbook methods answer (docs/desktop/spreadsheet-design.md). A service without it refuses a workbook as "not a PDF".

model.description: `provider/model-id`. Absent while no model is set up: `session/new` without a model then fails with `no_model`, and the person has to connect one.

cwd.description: Only sessions of this project (same matching as `finx sessions`).
Absolute path. Without one the session has no project: it works in an empty folder of its own, made for it (`no_project` in its summary).

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers for this session, on top of the configured ones; same name wins.
MCP servers for this session when it is loaded; not allowed for a loaded session.

agents.description: The sub-agents started since the session was loaded, in the order they started.

last_seq.description: The last event reflected here; later events have larger sequence numbers.

mcp_servers.description: The latest status of each MCP server, by name.

queued.description: Input waiting for the running task, as the last `queue_changed` gave it.

SessionState.description: What a session is doing, for lists.

oneOf.description: A task waits for an approval.
The last task failed.

model.description: The model the session uses (`provider/model-id`), when known.

no_project.description: Started without a project: `cwd` is the folder made for it.

preview.description: The start of the first user message.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339; the last activity: when a task last started or ended, else `created_at`. Opening, closing, renaming, archiving or changing settings does not move it.

sessions.description: Whole summaries of the sessions that changed or appeared.

chart.description: A chart sheet has no cells: the grid shows a placeholder.

columns.description: Column widths in pixels where they are not the default.

frozen.description: Frozen panes: rows above and columns left of the split.

protected.description: Protected in Excel: no edits here.

used.description: The used range, `A1:K120`; none for an empty sheet.

oneOf.description: A value, kept as given: text stays text (`"000001"`, `"=abc"`).
Empties the cells of a range, keeping their format.

SiteGrant.description: Permission for the browser tools on one origin, for the rest of the session (docs/kernel/browser-design.md §7.3).

SkillEntry.description: One `SKILL.md` that was found, and what became of it.

argument_hint.description: What to type after `/name`, from the header's `argument-hint`.

default_enabled.description: Whether it is on when the user has not turned it on or off: false for a project's `.claude/skills`, which `skills.opt_in` turns on. Then `disabled` means "off by default".

description.description: One line, at most 1,024 characters; empty when invalid.

detail.description: The winner's path when shadowed; the reason when invalid.

model_invocable.description: False when only the user may invoke it (`disable-model-invocation`).

name.description: From the header, or the directory's name when the header has none.

notes.description: Remarks that did not stop the skill from loading.

path.description: The `SKILL.md`, absolute, as found: symbolic links are kept.

removable.description: In `~/.finx/skills` (not built in), so `skills/remove` takes it.

oneOf.description: `~/.finx/skills`
`<project>/.finx/skills`

SkillScope.description: Where a skill comes from. Earlier layers win when names collide.

oneOf.description: Built into finx, written to `~/.finx/skills/.system`; after every other root.

SkillSource.description: `.finx-source.json` in a skill's directory: where finx installed it from.

sha256.description: Of the installed files; tells whether the user changed them since.

oneOf.description: From the application's catalog.
Picked by the user: a folder, an archive or a `SKILL.md`.
A skill of the same name with a higher priority is active.
Turned off by `skills.disabled`.
Not loaded: the header is broken or has no description.

SkillUse.description: A skill the user mentioned with `/skill:name`; its instructions went to the model with the message, which stays as the user wrote it.

SkillsChangedParams.description: `skills/changed`: a skill directory or a setting about skills changed.

cwd.description: Required for the project scope: a directory in the project.

dry_run.description: Read and check only; write nothing.

from.description: A skill directory, a `SKILL.md`, or a `.zip` or `.skill` archive.

replace.description: Replace a skill of the same name (moved to the trash first).

conflict.description: A dry run found a skill of the same name there.

skill.description: As installed; for a dry run, as it would be.

SkillsListParams.description: Parameters of `skills/list`: `session_id` or `cwd`, or neither for what a session without a project would find.

cwd.description: An absolute directory: every skill a session started there would find now, those it would not use included, and its catalog. The same as `finx skills --all --json`.

session_id.description: A loaded session: the skills it started with, described from their files now, and what typing `/` offers there.

commands.description: What typing `/` offers there: the built-in commands first, then the skills as `skill:name`.

not_read.description: Other apps' folders that hold skills but are not read (`skills.other_apps` is off).

file.description: A file in it, as `skills/files` lists it.

binary.description: Not UTF-8 text (an image, an archive, a program).

image.description: The file is a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image, by its signature: its bytes, to show.

text.description: Empty when the file is not text.

file.description: The user's configuration file that now lists or no longer lists it.

removed_names.description: A name-form entry for the same skill was removed too.

oneOf.description: Input from the user, or from the agent that started this session.
A sub-agent's report arrived while nothing was running.

ThinkingLevel.description: How hard a model thinks. `Default` sends nothing and leaves it to the provider; the others are the providers' own levels, and a model offers only those it supports (docs/kernel/model-catalog-design.md §18).

oneOf.description: Reasoning switched on, for models with a switch and no levels.

TokenPlanSummary.description: Connection details for a subscription product, never its secret or entitlement status.

ToolCategory.description: What a tool call does, for display. The values are a subset of the ACP tool kinds.

details.description: For user interfaces and logs; never sent to the model.

progress_tail.description: The most recent progress output, capped.

oneOf.description: What the cell reads (Excel's precedents).
What reads the cell (Excel's dependents).
A user or assistant message; `skills` as in `message_completed`. `mail` marks a sub-agent's report.
Where a task ended. Usage and reason are absent for tasks logged before they were recorded.

before.description: Cursor for earlier items (opaque); absent at the start of the session.

input.description: Input tokens that did not hit the cache.

reasoning.description: The reasoning part of `output`, when the provider reports it.

oneOf.description: `data` is base64 encoded.

WarningCode.description: Warnings a client may recognise. A client meeting a code it does not know shows `message`.

oneOf.description: The session runs in bypass-permissions: sent when it starts, resumes or switches into it.
MCP servers that were not ready for the session's first request. A client that shows `mcp_server_status` already has this.
A `resend` was refused and nothing changed: its input is still the client's.

WebSearchErrorKind.description: Why a search with a service failed.

at_ms.description: When, in milliseconds since the epoch.

WebSearchKeySource.description: Where a service's key comes from.

oneOf.description: Saved with `web_search/set_key`: it can be replaced and removed here.
An environment variable, named in `key_env`.
The model account's.

WebSearchNeeds.description: What a service needs before it can be used.

oneOf.description: It works as it is; a key only raises its limits.
A connected model account, whose key it shares.

WebSearchSetKeyResult.description: The result of `web_search/set_key`. A key the service refused is not saved; one that could not be tried is, and the service then goes first in the list, switched on.

WebSearchSource.description: One service, in the list's order.

enabled.description: Its switch: searches skip it when off.

failure.description: Its last search, when that failed; a search that works clears it.

key_env.description: The variable the key comes from.

current.description: The service searches use now: the first that is usable and whose last search did not fail.

YoursTab.description: A session's tab in the user's own browser, as the extension reports it: the extension keeps which tab is whose, across reconnects and restarts of the service (browser-design §8.4.7).

attached.description: The agent is attached to it now, so a task is using it; Chrome shows its debugging bar.

description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over newline-delimited JSON. Every message type is under `definitions`; the root accepts any top-level payload. `x-methods` maps each request to its params and result types, `x-client-notifications` and `x-server-notifications` map notifications to their params, and `x-error-codes` maps error codes to the `kind` in the error data.
